name: matrix bandwidth
domain: 车辆轨道基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 矩阵非零元素相对于主对角线的分布宽度。
usage_overview: 在轨道—下部结构系统的数值求解中，矩阵带宽是矩阵重组所针对的对象，通过调整非零项相对主对角线的分布范围改善求解效率。

complete_examples.text: The matrix reassembling tactic is based on the multi-scale assemble method, through which the finite element matrix bandwidth is greatly narrowed, and the Cholesky factorization, iterative and multi-time-step solution have been introduced to efficiently obtain the train, track and substructure responses.
By narrowing the matrix bandwidth, the system dynamic equations of motion in matrix form can be improved in sparsity and diagonality.
